slot.brief: Count selections/arrangements where at least one condition holds, using total minus the complementary cases.

stem: From a collection of $7$ mathematics books and $5$ physics books, a student chooses $4$ books. The number of ways in which at least one physics book is chosen is
working:
Total ways $= \binom{12}{4} = 495$. No physics book $= \binom{7}{4} = 35$. Required ways $= 495 - 35 = 460$.

Independent check: At least one physics book: \(\binom{12}{4}-\binom{7}{4}=495-35=460\).
solution:
Total selections are $\binom{12}{4}$; selections with no physics books are $\binom{7}{4}$.
$$\binom{12}{4}-\binom{7}{4}=495-35=460$$
